_notes: Scope: 1002 keys reviewed (agency + university); all 638 missing keys translated; existing strings changed only for meaning, one-term or typography defects.

One term per concept: document review = 'vérification' (was 'relecture' in the agency review queue; aligned with the fr student patch); essay review stays 'relecture'; verify action = 'Valider'; upload = 'Téléverser'; submitted = 'envoyée' (replaced 'soumises'); stage 'Consultation' (was 'Accompagnement'); caseload = 'vos dossiers'; plan = 'formule'; SLA kept as 'SLA'.

Official names: 표준입학허가서 = 'lettre d'admission standard' everywhere (replaced 'certificat d'admission'); 'apostille', 'légalisation consulaire', 'certification notariale' (notarization), D-2/D-4, CHSI, IEQAS kept.

University register: analytics questions rewritten formal and épicène ('Où les perdons-nous ?' -> 'À quelle étape les candidatures s'arrêtent-elles ?'); 'Offer rate' = 'Taux d'offres' (was 'Taux d'admission', which overstated the meaning); 'Yield' = 'Taux d'inscription'.

Épicène: administrator roles rendered as 'compte administrateur' / 'droits d'administration'; people referred to as 'personne' where English is gender-neutral. Short plural stage labels (Admis, Inscrits, Arrivés, Diplômés) keep the generic masculine as in existing stage labels; owner may prefer noun forms.
Typography: U+00A0 before : ; ! ? and % and inside « » in every new or touched string.

Owner decisions: (1) 'Associate' degree rendered 'Diplôme de premier cycle court' (no exact French equivalent); (2) 'today.afternoon' = 'Bonjour' (French has no afternoon greeting); (3) _many plural forms were not added because only _one/_other keys are in the job; (4) 'Yield' term choice.
